statements.text:
-- Manual product tags for local HTML review workflow.
--
-- Scope:
--   - Manual tags only. No automatic tag assignment.
--   - Assignments attach to review queue rows, not to original seller/stage data.
--   - Browser writes are limited by RLS to prepared sample batches.

create table if not exists public.product_tags (
  tag_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tag_name text not null unique,
  tag_color text not null default '#e2e8f0',
  description text,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_by text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint ck_product_tags_name
    check (length(btrim(tag_name)) between 1 and 32),
  constraint ck_product_tags_color
    check (tag_color ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')
)

create table if not exists public.product_tag_assignments (
  assignment_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tag_id uuid not null references public.product_tags(tag_id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
  source_batch_id text not null,
  source_channel text not null,
  queue_id bigint not null,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  channel_product_code text,
  channel_option_code text,
  reviewer text not null,
  memo text,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint ck_product_tag_assignments_reviewer
    check (length(btrim(reviewer)) between 1 and 64)
)

create unique index if not exists ux_product_tag_assignments_current_queue_tag
  on public.product_tag_assignments(queue_id, tag_id)
  where is_active = true

create index if not exists ix_product_tag_assignments_queue
  on public.product_tag_assignments(queue_id, is_active)

create index if not exists ix_product_tag_assignments_tag
  on public.product_tag_assignments(tag_id, is_active)

create index if not exists ix_product_tag_assignments_channel
  on public.product_tag_assignments(source_channel, source_batch_id, is_active)
alter table public.product_tags enable row level security
alter table public.product_tag_assignments enable row level security
drop policy if exists "product tags readable" on public.product_tags

create policy "product tags readable"
  on public.product_tags
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true)
drop policy if exists "product tags insertable" on public.product_tags

create policy "product tags insertable"
  on public.product_tags
  for insert
  to anon, authenticated
  with check (
    is_active = true
    and length(btrim(tag_name)) between 1 and 32
    and tag_color ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'
  )
drop policy if exists "product tag assignments readable" on public.product_tag_assignments

create policy "product tag assignments readable"
  on public.product_tag_assignments
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (
    source_batch_id in (
      'sample_smartstore_100',
      'sample_makeshop_100',
      'sample_smartstore_500',
      'sample_makeshop_500'
    )
  )
drop policy if exists "product tag assignments insertable" on public.product_tag_assignments

create policy "product tag assignments insertable"
  on public.product_tag_assignments
  for insert
  to anon, authenticated
  with check (
    is_active = true
    and length(btrim(reviewer)) between 1 and 64
    and source_batch_id in (
      'sample_smartstore_100',
      'sample_makeshop_100',
      'sample_smartstore_500',
      'sample_makeshop_500'
    )
  )
drop policy if exists "product tag assignments updatable" on public.product_tag_assignments

create policy "product tag assignments updatable"
  on public.product_tag_assignments
  for update
  to anon, authenticated
  using (
    source_batch_id in (
      'sample_smartstore_100',
      'sample_makeshop_100',
      'sample_smartstore_500',
      'sample_makeshop_500'
    )
  )
  with check (
    source_batch_id in (
      'sample_smartstore_100',
      'sample_makeshop_100',
      'sample_smartstore_500',
      'sample_makeshop_500'
    )
  )
grant select, insert on public.product_tags to anon, authenticated
grant select, insert, update on public.product_tag_assignments to anon, authenticated

create or replace view public.mapping_matrix_review_sample_v3
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  q.*,
  coalesce(tag_data.tags, '[]'::jsonb) as manual_tags,
  coalesce(tag_data.tag_names, array[]::text[]) as manual_tag_names,
  coalesce(cardinality(tag_data.tag_names), 0) as manual_tag_count,
  coalesce(cardinality(tag_data.tag_names), 0) > 0 as has_manual_tag
from public.mapping_matrix_review_sample_v2 q
left join lateral (
  select
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'assignment_id', a.assignment_id,
        'tag_id', t.tag_id,
        'tag_name', t.tag_name,
        'tag_color', t.tag_color,
        'memo', a.memo,
        'reviewer', a.reviewer,
        'created_at', a.created_at
      )
      order by t.tag_name
    ) as tags,
    array_agg(t.tag_name order by t.tag_name) as tag_names
  from public.product_tag_assignments a
  join public.product_tags t
    on t.tag_id = a.tag_id
   and t.is_active = true
  where a.queue_id = q.queue_id
    and a.is_active = true
) tag_data on true
grant select on public.mapping_matrix_review_sample_v3 to anon, authenticated
